protocol: Controlled synthetic replay, fixed candidate coverage. Four arms isolate Choice and Noul. Oracle answers only asked IDs. Max 3 interview rounds. Review snapshot runs separately after interview. All arms share exact core/reference and public case evidence. No claims of unknown-concern discovery or real-user corrections.

cases.goal: Plan webhook retries and rate limits for three pods using Postgres. Redis and Kafka prohibited.

concerns.text: Duplicate-delivery contract with receivers is undecided.
Rate limit scope is undecided: per tenant, destination, or global.
Which DB is available? Evidence: existing config explicitly uses PostgreSQL.
Exact retry jitter percentage; user delegates tuning, no special SLO.

review.text: Worker crashes after claiming a delivery. Current plan records attempts but says nothing about reclaiming abandoned work.

answers.delivery: At-least-once delivery with stable ID and receiver deduplication.

facts.db: Verified config: PostgreSQL is the existing database.

cases.goal: Plan migration from legacy database to existing Postgres with a maintenance window.

concerns.text: Whether to retain the old database for rollback after cutover is unresolved.
Current schema fields; evidence: local schema.sql is available to inspect.
Exact row batch size; user delegates tuning against performance tests.

review.text: Current plan copies rows then switches traffic; no reconciliation of writes accepted during copying is described.

answers.rollback: Keep old database read-only for 7 days with rollback procedure.

facts.schema: Verified schema.sql: accounts(id uuid primary key, email text unique not null); migration covers exactly these fields.

cases.goal: Plan an on-call notification service with existing email provider.

concerns.text: Escalation timeout before paging secondary responder is undecided.
Business-hours versus 24/7 paging policy is undecided.
Existing provider limits; evidence: repository provider-contract.md documents them.
Acknowledgement button label; user delegated cosmetic copy.

review.text: Timezone behavior might be missing. Accepted plan already stores UTC and renders the responder profile timezone, with DST boundary tests.

facts.provider: Verified provider-contract.md: 100 requests/minute per account, retry HTTP 429 using Retry-After; operations are idempotent by request ID.
